source_audit.anchor: Frozen LA01 primary claims and anchors

methods.scientific_role: Predict pairwise causal assertions from variable descriptions.
methods.counterexample: A familiar word pair may be recalled from training while the target bank has a different assignment mechanism.
methods.candidate_remedy: Test unfamiliar mechanism/label combinations and context-specific evidence; preserve abstention.
methods.remaining_limit: Novel labels reduce a shortcut but do not establish true mechanisms.

methods.scientific_role: Propose graph neighborhoods with fewer model calls.
methods.counterexample: The acyclic reverse graph in LA02 has the same observed table and a different causal effect.
methods.candidate_remedy: Keep equivalent graph alternatives and measure tokens/latency as well as calls.
methods.remaining_limit: Syntactic DAG validity and lower call count do not establish scientific truth or full cost.

methods.scientific_role: Use distributions of YES/NO model responses as discovery input.
methods.counterexample: Same-batch category proportions have negative covariance; an independent-proportion standard error can reject too often even under a simple response null.
methods.candidate_remedy: Use a correct declared response-sampling model, independent numerical CI tests and type-separated result fields.
methods.remaining_limit: Calibrated response uncertainty still says nothing by itself about bank conditional independence.

methods.scientific_role: Retrieve evidence for relationships and assumption audits.
methods.counterexample: LACR documents reduce ASIA skeleton F1 in the inspected reported experiment; a retrieval miss can masquerade as evidence absence.
methods.candidate_remedy: Adversarial/wrong-domain retrieval ablations, exact anchors and separate retrieval-failure labels.
methods.remaining_limit: A relevant citation may still be inapplicable or scientifically wrong.

methods.scientific_role: Turn metadata and language judgments into ancestral path constraints or penalties.
methods.counterexample: A->M->Y makes A an ancestor of Y without an A->Y direct edge; an importer can silently change the constraint.
methods.candidate_remedy: Represent path and adjacency constraints with different types and test their conversion.
methods.remaining_limit: Correct type conversion does not validate the elicited constraint or its independence approximation.

methods.scientific_role: Combine data score with a language-derived soft preference over graphs.
methods.counterexample: A wrong high-weight prior can dominate a weak likelihood even when every DAG keeps positive prior support.
methods.candidate_remedy: Predeclare prior strength, compare the zero-prior baseline and inspect contradictory evidence.
methods.remaining_limit: Soft support is not calibrated graph coverage, especially after pruning.

methods.scientific_role: Feed numerical discovery summaries to an LLM and threshold its responses into method-specific constraints.
methods.counterexample: The same dataset can drive both the initial evidence and the generated restriction; treating them as independent multiplies the same information.
methods.candidate_remedy: Track reuse, validate the actual joint procedure and preserve forced/forbidden/unknown states.
methods.remaining_limit: Sample splitting does not establish prior truth or all downstream assumptions.

methods.scientific_role: Assign causal-discovery roles and aggregate debate among models.
methods.counterexample: Agents sharing a model, corpus or retrieved text can agree on the same erroneous collider orientation.
methods.candidate_remedy: Compare to one-agent and no-language baselines; cluster perturbations by mechanism and shared source.
methods.remaining_limit: Agent diversity does not supply independent scientific observations.

methods.scientific_role: Initialize numerical temporal graph/intervention-target optimization from textual system information.
methods.counterexample: An anomaly produced by an unobserved market shock is not necessarily a verified intervention regime.
methods.candidate_remedy: Audit regime/clock assumptions and compare random, language and expert initialization with identical data.
methods.remaining_limit: Population optimization claims do not certify a stochastic optimizer or finite-sample uncertainty.

methods.scientific_role: Allocate language queries across successive contemporaneous observation batches while retaining PAG outputs.
methods.counterexample: A confident answer histogram can orient the wrong edge; successive batches are not dynamic treatment histories.
methods.candidate_remedy: Preserve circle endpoints and model the query channel separately; evaluate downstream effect sets.
methods.remaining_limit: No general simultaneous graph or temporal policy confidence follows from response entropy.

methods.scientific_role: Use a pretrained numerical transformer to estimate temporal graphs.
methods.counterexample: A hidden common cause violates the inspected sufficient, lagged-only model class even if predictions are accurate.
methods.candidate_remedy: Use regime-specific assumption screens and compare numerical baselines; acquire exact weights before execution.
methods.remaining_limit: This adjacent model is not an LLM and cannot diagnose every violated assumption.

methods.scientific_role: Propose mechanisms/strategies, fit them numerically and acquire new intervention information.
methods.counterexample: An adaptively pruned model pool can omit a policy-relevant mechanism, while finite prediction remains good.
methods.candidate_remedy: Retain residual checks and alternative pools; compare acquisitions under matched intervention and total-cost budgets.
methods.remaining_limit: Open-loop finite predictive success is not closed-loop bank-policy identification.

methods.scientific_role: Use an assistant for data review, assumption elicitation and fixed tool calls around a formal core.
methods.counterexample: A valid tool can still receive a wrong variable mapping, target or scientific assumption.
methods.candidate_remedy: Bind full semantic context and preserve algorithm outputs/refusals; test altered targets and missing sources.
methods.remaining_limit: Transport and schema conformance do not verify causal premises.

scope: No matched package/LLM experiment was executed.
